episode.episode_title: The Price of AI: When a Signed Contract Isn't Quite Final
episode.episode_description: Major server manufacturers are asking for significant price hikes on existing orders, leaving enterprise buyers in a difficult spot. We look at why your hardware budget might be about to evaporate.

selected_story.headline: AI server suppliers demand double-digit price hikes on signed contracts
selected_story.source_title: Sources: AI server suppliers like Dell, HPE, Lenovo, and Supermicro are demanding substantially higher prices from buyers, months after contracts were signed (Financial Times)

short.title: AI server suppliers demand double-digit price hikes on signed contracts
short.description:
Fixed-price infrastructure planning is becoming increasingly difficult for enterprises, as evidenced by XTX Markets suing Dell over a demanded $62M–$70M price increase on a $549M order.
